chain.label: Night flight with no ground light references
chain.trigger: at night, with low cloud ceilings, reduced visibility, and no surface light references

chain.label: MSP lacked effective risk management and downgraded instrument training
chain.trigger: at the time of the accident, MSP did not have a formal risk management program in place; MSP changed its instrument training program about 10 months before the accident

chain.label: Pilot's limited recent instrument flight experience
chain.trigger: after the change and in the year prior to the accident, the pilot logged instrument time on only 2 flights...2.1 hours of instrument time and 4 instrument approaches

caused_by.evidence: changes made by the MSP Aviation Command to its instrument training program about 10 months before the accident did not promote instrument proficiency

chain.label: Pilot likely fatigued, risk factors for sleep apnea
chain.trigger: the pilot displayed two significant risk factors for obstructive sleep apnea: obesity and loud snoring

chain.label: Pilot's inadequate assessment of the weather
chain.trigger: the 1851 DUAT briefing did not include weather hazards because the pilot did not select them from the DUAT menu of products

chain.label: Pilot's decision to accept the medevac flight
chain.trigger: "yeah we ought to be able to do it…we're going to try it"

caused_by.evidence: the pilot's decision to accept the flight, after his inadequate assessment of the weather, contributed to the accident
had a formal flight risk evaluation program been in place at MSP before the accident, it may have resulted in the cancellation of the flight

chain.label: Encountered IMC en route, diverted to ADW
chain.trigger: Trooper 2 encountered instrument meteorological conditions en route to the hospital and diverted to ADW

caused_by.evidence: night visual meteorological conditions prevailed for the departure; however, Trooper 2 encountered instrument meteorological conditions en route

chain.label: ATC deficiencies: stale weather report, poor vectoring, ASR unavailable
chain.trigger: the latest weather at Andrews is 7 miles uh 1,800 broken...issued almost 5 hours earlier; the controller replied that she was not current to provide that [ASR] service

chain.label: Pilot reported not receiving a valid glideslope signal

caused_by.evidence: the lack of information regarding...flight instrument indications precluded NTSB investigators from determining why the pilot believed he was not receiving a valid glideslope signal

chain.label: Pilot attempted rapid descent to 'duck under' the clouds
chain.trigger: the helicopter's rate of descent increased rapidly from about 500 feet per minute to greater than 2,000 fpm

caused_by.evidence: the failure of the PCT controller to provide the current ADW weather information likely led the pilot to expect that he could descend below the cloud ceiling
once the controller denied [the ASR request], the pilot still had many options available to conduct a safe landing
this lack of proficiency likely contributed to the pilot's failure to properly conduct what effectively became a nonprecision approach

chain.label: Pilot failed to arrest descent at the minimum descent altitude
chain.trigger: no evidence was found to indicate that the pilot made any attempt to arrest the helicopter's descent before impact

caused_by.evidence: the pilot failed to adhere to instrument approach procedures when he did not arrest the helicopter's descent at the MDA
fatigue may have contributed to his deficient decision-making
at night, with low cloud ceilings, reduced visibility, and no surface light references, there were insufficient visual cues available for the pilot to establish ground reference

chain.label: Helicopter struck trees and terrain
chain.trigger: the helicopter initially collided with the upper section of an 80-foot tree in a level, descending attitude

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter continued the descent...before impacting trees and terrain about 3.2 miles north of the runway threshold

chain.label: Four fatalities, one serious injury
chain.trigger: the commercial pilot, one flight paramedic, one field provider, and one of two automobile accident patients being transported were killed

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter was substantially damaged when it collided with trees and terrain
